audit_evidence.location: Results: Specific Translocation Results; Table 5 (EWSR1-ETV1 row); Methods: data collection
audit_evidence.scope: Reported local translocation test results from 305 enrolled patients; Table 5 specifically records EWSR1-ETV1. This is primary clinical data, not centralized sequence-level functional validation.

Direct cohort includes 26 EWSR1-ERG tumors and rare EWSR1-ETV1/4 tumors. Figure 4 shows EWSR1-ERG examples; Figures 3–4 show EWSR1-ETV4 infant case. No pair-specific functional transactivation experiment.

report_comment.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription. ETV1 encodes an ETS-family transcription factor. EWSR1::ETV1 is a rare Ewing sarcoma fusion documented in clinical translocation-testing data and in a molecularly characterized Ewing sarcoma cohort.
